reconstruction.scope: Specific Palace Kitchens range on OSM way32396096: long stone kitchen hall, ten approximate cooking roof bays with lead domes and tall pale open-topped chimneys, recessed arched upper screens and lower doors, northern connecting range and west courtyard range with brick rear wall and a genuinely open pale-column arcade. Preserve the long unroofed service court and all separate palace members. Original medium-fi interpretation; no furnished kitchens, copied inscriptions, people, trees, pots or museum cases.
